name: Conservation and Recycling Practices in Rural Areas
description: Introduction to philosophy of conservation and sustainable practices in rural areas; concept of sustainability and circular economy; traditional ecological knowledge; soil conservation and sustainable agricultural practices; traditional water conservation practices; circularity of agri-residues and other solid wastes; water and wastewater circularity; conservation of energy and materials in rural industries; emerging contaminants and concerns with recycling; policies and legislation for resource conservation.
